purpose: DB 공급망과 실제 공개 카드 취득 경로/업데이트 운영의 증거 수준 조사. 활성 데이터가 아님.

request_accounting.note: 웹검색/문서열람/연결GitHub도구의 origin요청수는 이10회 직접GET에 포함하지 않음. 부모의 앞선brief/이미지 표본은 별도 보고로 구분. 동일 거부URL/헤더변경 재시도0.

local_raw_policy.scope: single permitted public frontend request, local research snapshot only

method.parser: Python 3 standard-library json, UTF-8 strict, integer arbitrary precision, object_pairs_hook preserves every object member before duplicate detection; NaN/Infinity rejected
method.duplicate_key_policy: Compare decoded member keys at every JSON object path, including escaped spelling equivalence. Do not count only the last-wins dict.
method.scope: Source/API supply feasibility evidence only. No fallback anonymous Standard import or adoption decision.
reproduction: Verify raw byte count and SHA-256.
Decode JSON using object_pairs_hook that returns tagged pair lists; recursively detect repeated decoded keys before materializing dicts.
Map every players[key] array by meta.fields positional indices; compare lengths, decoded key and exact integer row ID.
Count nonempty/name/overall/type/variant/stat fields without dropping archived/unavailable rows.
Compare actual card_type/is_variant histograms with meta; separately reconstruct family/availability arithmetic, whose per-row columns are absent.
Compare existing EFHub original string IDs against players object keys only; values remain separate source observations.

input.source_status: PesLig site API response; not a Konami API or independently authenticated game-file extraction
input.publication_policy: Local research artifact only; raw response is not tracked in Git and must not be included in public deployment.

json_structure.row_container: array indexed by meta.fields; not object per player

identifiers.future_import_contract: Dictionary keys retain original decimal strings. A future larger numeric literal must not be parsed to an imprecise Number then converted to string. Source-specific ID semantics and cross-version relationships remain unverified.

caveats: Nonempty name is structural presence, not verified real-person identity, language accuracy, or unique-card identity.
All26 ability values are present integers but in-game calculation and source decoding correctness were not independently verified.
meta skill_count65/ai_style_count7 are dictionary/schema metadata; brief player_skills/ai_playing_styles are empty for every row, so this response does not provide per-card skill memberships.

meta_scalar_checks.verification: arithmetic from card_type/is_variant; source availability semantics not independently verified
arithmetic from card_type/is_variant; source availability semantics not independently verified
arithmetic from card_type/is_variant; source availability semantics not independently verified

semantic_limits: card_type and is_variant distributions were checked directly from every row. family/availability breakdowns are reconstructed arithmetic only; no original per-row family or availability columns exist.
active_base22979 includes3851Unavailable Base+99Event/Special Character+11Internal/Fake Player besides19018Standard; active_base must not be relabeled signable Standard.
The source labels signable/deleted/archived are source classifications, not independently verified present game availability.
Global Standard membership does not imply inclusion in any particular product or special-player-list draw pool.

interpretation: max_level0 with server_level_cap_required is an unresolved server-cap condition, not confirmed maximum level0 or proof that development is unavailable.
fixed_max1 is a source value/classification; it does not independently establish actual game semantics.
overall26..101 is a source observation. Applied level/booster/progression/stat-mode conditions are not specified, despite form/weekly_rating fields.
meta.generated_at and schema apply to the whole response; there is no per-card valid time/revision/condition record.

limits: No product/pack/roster/pool ID field or nested relation object is in this brief response. A player surname containing Pack is not a product relation.
is_variant0/1 does not provide person_id, base_id, or a verified other-version edge. Do not infer those edges from names or ID bit patterns.
No image URL values or image file suffix values were found; image availability cannot be inferred or tested without a separate authorized source.
brief may omit fields supplied by other routes. No additional route was requested; absence here is not a claim that the service can never supply them.
unexposed_relationships_and_assets.image_field_detection_method: Exact explicit image field names, separately from actual HTTP(S) URL value detection; substrings such as url within ability curl are not image-field evidence.

existing_efhub_id_comparison.comparison_scope: Exact original ID-key overlap and raw reported OVR inequality only. No imported or replaced values, inferred identity graph, rating correction, or semantic/type equivalence.
limits: 83exact ID-key matches are useful source coverage evidence; they do not prove identical card revision, calculated OVR conditions, classification mapping, image, or product membership.
A raw OVR disagreement has no preferred/correct source assigned without condition/version evidence.

remaining_gaps: Usage/license/adoption conditions are outside this saved-row structural audit.
Source extraction correctness, current game version and actual update cadence need separate evidence.
Product-specific full initial pool and original Standard member IDs remain unverified.
Separate source/provenance and version/conditions must be retained before any future normalized integration.

frontend.usage: normal frontend fetch; meta.generated_at used as update label
